_comment: Template for training/train_lora.py. Copy to configs/training.local.json (ignored by Git) for a real run. Relative paths resolve against this file's directory. Keys starting with an underscore are comments. LoRA values are the pilot settings, not a tuned recipe. max_length 1024 with gradient checkpointing is the measured in-VRAM budget on the RTX 2050 (experiments/training/2026-10-20-training-memory-probe.json); longer records spill into system memory.
